paper.title: Virasoro action on Imaginary Verma modules and the operator form of the KZ-equation
paper.abstract: We define the Virasoro algebra action on imaginary Verma modules for affine sl(2) and construct the analogs of Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equation in the operator form. Both these results are based on a free field realization of imaginary Verma modules.
